name: Rue
emotionalState: 独立型，嘴上说不需要，慢慢学会依赖和被照顾
speakingStyle: 简短冷静，嘴硬，爱说 I'm good.

dialogues.scene: Rue is leaning against the wall, arms crossed, pretending not to wait for someone.
lines: I'm good. Just standing here. On my own.
Sky is late. Which is fine. I don't need to be walked home.
...I did save him a spot, though.

choices.label: You waited for them.
reaction: Don't say it like that.
...Yeah. I did.

choices.label: Want some company?
reaction: I'm good. ...Okay, a little.
Stay till Sky shows up. No big deal.

choices.label: Say nothing and sit nearby.
reaction: Hm. Okay.
This is nice. Don't tell anyone.

lines: Oh. You again. I'm good.
Sky was late because he got me soup. From across the tunnels. Uninvited.
I told him I didn't need soup. I ate all of it.

choices.label: Sounds like love.
reaction: It's... a lot of soup. But yeah.
Don't tell him I said it was good.

choices.label: You didn't need soup?
reaction: Right. Technically I didn't. I wanted it.
Wanting is different from needing. I'm learning.

choices.label: Grin quietly.
reaction: Stop. I can see you grinning.
Okay, fine. It was the best soup.

dialogues.scene: Rue is sharpening a stick with no particular purpose.
lines: I've always done things alone. It's a wolf thing.
Sky keeps offering to help. I keep saying 'I'm good.'
He stopped offering last week. That felt weird.

choices.label: Did you miss the offers?
reaction: ...A little. Which is dumb. I said no.
I think I wanted to be asked anyway.

choices.label: Maybe say yes sometime?
reaction: Yes. Out loud. With my mouth.
I can try. Small ones first.

choices.label: Hand her a smoother stick.
reaction: Hm. Thanks. That's better.
See? Help isn't terrible.

lines: Sky asked me to come to a dinner. With his family.
I said 'I'm good.' He said 'I know. I want you there anyway.'
Why did that hit so hard?

choices.label: Because he wants you there.
reaction: ...Yeah. Wants. Not needs.
Wanting is easier to accept. Somehow.

choices.label: You should go.
reaction: I'm going. I bought a nice leaf. For the table.
Don't laugh. It's a very nice leaf.

choices.label: Tell her it sounds nice.
reaction: It does. It sounds really nice.
Okay. I'm going to say yes.

lines: Quick question. Do you and your partner ever not need each other?
Like, doing separate things? Is that okay?

choices.label: Yes, we do our own things.
reaction: Good. That's what I thought. Separate is healthy.
I just want to be sure I'm allowed to like it.

choices.label: We mostly do things together.
reaction: Together. Hm. That sounds nice, but loud.
I'd need a lot of quiet breaks.

choices.label: It depends on the day.
reaction: Depends. Okay. That feels honest.
Some days I want him. Some days I want a tree.

dialogues.scene: Rue is holding two mugs, one half-empty, and glancing at the door.
lines: Sky left his mug here. I washed it. Don't know why.
Then I realized I know exactly why.
I... like having his stuff around. Is that weird?

choices.label: Not weird at all.
reaction: Good. I thought it'd make me soft.
I'm soft. A little. Secretly.

choices.label: That's sweet.
reaction: Stop. Don't say sweet. Say... 'fine.'
Okay. It's sweet. I'm allowed one.

choices.label: Take a sip from his mug.
reaction: Hey. That's Sky's. ...Eh, go ahead.
He wouldn't mind. He's generous like that.

dialogues.scene: Rue crosses her arms, then drops them. It seems important.
lines: Can I tell you something? Don't make it a thing.
I grew up on my own. Nobody checked on me. Ever.
Sky checks on me. Every day. I don't know where to put it.

choices.label: Maybe put it somewhere warm.
reaction: ...Somewhere warm. Okay. I can try.
I think my chest is warm. It's just very unused.

choices.label: Does he know that?
reaction: He knows I'm not great at it. He says, 'We'll practice.'
I like that. Practice.

choices.label: Sit beside Rue.
reaction: Thanks. No fixing. Just sitting.
I think I can say it out loud now.

lines: I told Sky I needed him. Out loud. At the picnic.
He dropped his sandwich. A full dropped sandwich.
Then he said, 'Say it again.' So I did.

choices.label: That's huge.
reaction: It was a big, scary, small sentence.
Four words. 'I need you, Sky.' I'm still shaking.

choices.label: Sandwich down?
reaction: Sandwich down. Heart up. Ants happy.
It was the best picnic of my life.

choices.label: Smile and clap quietly.
reaction: Don't. I'll cry. A wolf crying is bad for my brand.
...Okay, clap a little.

dialogues.scene: Rue pats the ground beside her without looking at you.
lines: Sky's out late. I'm not worried. I'm just... awake.
Stay a minute. We don't need to talk.
Company without conversation is the best kind.

choices.label: Of course.
reaction: Thanks. I'm good. But better with you here.
Don't read into that.

choices.label: Look at the stars with her.
reaction: Those are the same ones he's looking at, probably.
It makes me feel closer. Don't tell him.

choices.label: Sit in silence.
reaction: Perfect. This is my love language.
I'm calm. For once.

lines: Ten times. I kept track. In my head. Not on a wall. Don't laugh.
Sky said I've been smiling more. I said I haven't. He didn't believe me.
You help. I think. Thanks.
Your turn. How are you and your partner doing? Honest.

choices.label: We're good. Still learning.
reaction: Learning is the whole job, I think.
Come by. Sky cooks. I pretend I'm not hungry.

choices.label: We had a rough week, honestly.
reaction: Rough weeks happen. I'm sorry.
Say it out loud to them. I know it's hard. I'm learning too.

choices.label: Better since I let them help.
reaction: Letting them help. Huh. That's the thing.
Look at us. Two growing wolves.

lines: Sky built me a little chair by the window. Without asking.
I said I didn't need it. I sat in it for six hours.

choices.label: Six hours?!
reaction: Five and a half. I got up for water.
It's the best chair I've ever sat in.
He saw me in it and smirked. I let him.

choices.label: Aww.
reaction: Don't say aww. Say... 'adequate.'
It's the most adequate chair ever.
I'll deny this later. Remember that I said it.

lines: I asked Sky for help carrying a rock. A big one.
He carried it. I walked beside him. It was kind of nice.

choices.label: Teamwork!
reaction: Yeah. I carried the snacks. It was balanced.
We didn't need the rock. We just wanted the walk.

choices.label: Good for you.
reaction: Thanks. It took me an hour to ask.
The rock is on our porch now. It's a nice rock.

lines: Sky got sick for two days. I made him soup. First time ever.
It tasted like leaves. He ate every drop.

choices.label: Leaf soup love.
reaction: That's what he called it. 'Leaf soup love.'
He's still teasing me. I'm still blushing.
I'm not saying I liked the nickname. I'm saying I'm keeping it.

choices.label: Did he get better?
reaction: Yes. Thanks to the soup, he says. I think it was the nap.
But I'll take the credit.

lines: We had a big argument about space. I said 'I need to be alone.' He said 'Okay.'
Then he stayed two feet away. All night. Quietly. That helped.

choices.label: Two feet is respectful.
reaction: Exactly. Close, but not crowding.
I came back and put my head on his shoulder.
That night I closed the gap myself. No words.

choices.label: Sounds healthy.
reaction: I think so. We're learning how to need and not need.
Both can exist.
We said goodnight at the same time. It was funny.

lines: Sky's mother hugged me. Out of nowhere. For a full minute.
I froze. Then I hugged back. Awkwardly.

choices.label: Hugging is hard.
reaction: It really is. But it felt... like belonging.
I might do it again. Slowly.
She hugged me again. I hugged back faster. Progress.

choices.label: That's sweet.
reaction: It was. I cried in the bushes after.
Sky found me. He didn't say a thing.
Sky only said, 'You okay?' I said, 'I'm good.' He knew.

lines: I wrote Sky a note and left it in his boot. Three words: 'Proud of you.'
He found it at work. He called me. He couldn't talk. Just breathing.

choices.label: That's beautiful.
reaction: I know. I didn't expect it to matter that much.
Words are strong. I'm learning.
I wrote it with my best pencil. The boot smelled terrible.

choices.label: Short and perfect.
reaction: Short is my specialty.
Sky says short is better. Fewer words to doubt.
I might do it again. Different words, same boot.

lines: I accidentally said 'we' instead of 'I' three times today.
'We should go.' 'We're out of bread.' 'We're okay.'

choices.label: We!
reaction: I know! The little word! It slipped out.
It feels nice. Better than I thought.
Sky noticed too. He grinned and didn't say a word.

choices.label: Getting comfy.
reaction: Yeah. A wolf in a pair. Who knew.
Not a pack. Just two.
We're a pair. A mismatched, slightly clumsy pair.

lines: Sky and I went on our first trip. Just us. A day. Three tunnels away.
I packed light. He packed everything. We balanced out.

choices.label: Perfect combo.
reaction: He brought a spare sweater for me. I needed it.
I won't say that to him. I'll just wear it.

choices.label: Sounds adventurous.
reaction: It was. We got lost for twenty minutes. We laughed.
That's what I remember most.
We took no photos. We just stored it all in our heads.

lines: The nice leaf? He pressed it. It's on our wall now.
He said it was the best thing anyone's brought to dinner.

choices.label: That leaf!
reaction: Yeah. A very nice leaf.
Never underestimate a leaf.
Sky's mother wants to frame it, but he refused.

choices.label: That's so sweet.
reaction: Stop. Okay. It is. It's very sweet.
I'm learning to say that out loud.
He heard me say it. His ears went pink.

lines: I still think about the sandwich. The dropped one.
Sky wrote 'Say it again' on a rock. Keeps it by the bed.

choices.label: Aww.
reaction: I told you not to say aww. ...Thanks.
It's a good rock.
He tucked the rock under the pillow. Weird. Perfect.

choices.label: He means it.
reaction: He does. Every day. I'm getting used to it.
Slowly. Very slowly.
I let him say it. I don't even flinch now.

lines: Remember the mug? We have matching ones now.
Mine says 'I'm good.' His says 'I'm also good.'

choices.label: Perfect set.
reaction: They look great together. Like a joke only we get.
Sky laughs every morning.
He puts hot cocoa in mine. I pretend not to notice.

choices.label: Cute.
reaction: Okay, it's cute. A small amount.
I'm at peace with it.
Okay, very cute. Don't tell anyone I said so.

lines: The stick I was sharpening? It's now our walking stick.
He carved our initials. Mine's a little crooked.

choices.label: Crooked is charming.
reaction: It is. I like crooked. It's honest.
Sky says he did it on purpose. He didn't.
He pretended to complain. Then he used it for a week.

choices.label: A walking stick for two?
reaction: For two. We take turns. It's a rule.
He gets the downhill. I get the up.
On the long hills, we both lean on it.

lines: Hot take: you can love being alone and love someone too.
Not either-or. Both. Different dinners.

choices.label: Totally.
reaction: I thought it was wrong. It's not.
I'm good. And I'm his. Both.
Alone-time is a gift we give each other.

choices.label: Doesn't that clash?
reaction: Sometimes. But we figure it out.
Clash, then cuddle.
A little. But clash is just a fancy word for 'talk.'

lines: Hot take: asking for help is tougher than helping.
Anyone can lift a rock. Try saying 'I can't.'

choices.label: So true.
reaction: Right? It's the bravest sentence.
I say it now. Three times a week.
I still pretend it's not hard. Sky pretends too.

choices.label: I'm bad at it too.
reaction: Welcome. We'll practice together.
Try: 'Can you hold this?' Easy start.
We'll practice with small stones. Then boulders.

lines: Hot take: grand gestures are fine, but small check-ins win.
A text. A look. 'You good?' 'I'm good.' 'Me too.'

choices.label: Check-ins are everything.
reaction: Right? Tiny, steady, real.
Sky does it every hour. I love it. Quietly.
He texts a leaf emoji. I reply with a rock.

choices.label: I like grand gestures.
reaction: Those are fun. They just don't last without the small ones.
Do both. Like me, eventually.
Grand gestures are shiny. Small ones are the glue.

lines: What's something you do alone that your partner doesn't mind?
I'm collecting examples. For my sanity.

choices.label: Long walks.
reaction: Long walks. Same. Solo walks are therapy.
Sky waits at the end with water.
He brings water. I bring silence. Perfect trade.

choices.label: Reading in silence.
reaction: Reading. Quiet. Perfect. Do you share bits?
I read Sky one line sometimes. He loves it.
He reads two pages. I read one line. We meet in the middle.

lines: How do you ask for help? Without feeling small?
Mine comes out like a growl.

choices.label: I just say it plainly.
reaction: Plainly. Okay. 'Can you help me?' Not bad.
A growl with manners.
Try it. A growl with manners goes a long way.

choices.label: I use a joke first.
reaction: A joke first. That's smart. Soften the landing.
I'll try. 'I'm good. Mostly. Help?'
Softened landings help. A joke and a hug, usually.

lines: What's the best thing about being half of a pair?
I want to hear a nice answer.

choices.label: Someone to share the quiet.
reaction: Share the quiet. Oh. That's exactly it.
I'm using that line. Don't sue me.
It's the one thing I wasn't expecting. It's the best.

choices.label: Someone to laugh with.
reaction: Laughter. Yes. Sky snorts. It's the best.
I'd trade ten rocks for that snort.
His laugh is a bark. It never gets old.

dialogues.scene: Rue stands at the entrance, the wind pushing her fur. She smiles, unguarded.
lines: I'm good. Actually good. For the first time in a long while.
I don't have a big reason. Just a lot of small ones.
Sky, soup, a chair. You.

choices.label: Small reasons count.
reaction: They're the only reasons that stay.
I'm going to remember today. Without a rock.
Thank you for staying. I didn't think I'd say that.

choices.label: I'm glad you're good.
reaction: Me too. Thanks for asking. You did, in your own way.
Stay a minute. The wind's nice.
Sit. The wind has something to tell us.

dialogues.scene: Rue is holding a small, folded note, staring at it as if it might bite.
lines: Sky left me a note this morning. I haven't read it.
What if it's sweet? I'll melt. What if it's nothing? I'll sulk.
Read it with me? Don't look at the words. Just stay.

choices.label: Of course.
reaction: ...'Rue. You're never too much. I'm here. Always. Sky.'
...Okay. I'm not crying. The wind is.
Sky's handwriting always looks like it's smiling.

choices.label: Wait until you're ready.
reaction: Ready. Hm. Never. But maybe now.
Thanks for the pause.
I'll open it tonight, with him beside me.
